descriptions.descr-1: Heavy Engineering is an engineering integrator specializing in sulfuric acid production technologies and other large-scale industrial processes. Our core activities include process unit design in cooperation with leading global licensors, supply of complex process equipment, and supply and service support of industrial catalysts.
descriptions.descr-2: Heavy Engineering LLC (HE) is a technology partner and distributor of the Russian sulfur dioxide oxidation catalyst manufacturer JSC "SZK". We are also an official agent and distributor of Keyontechs Group (Keyon Process Co., LTD.). Our customers include mineral fertilizer producers, non-ferrous metallurgy enterprises, and oil refineries. Our key competence lies in a team of highly qualified engineers, technologists, and experts with unique long-term experience gained in leading international and Russian companies.

catalysts.title: CATALYSTS AND SERVICES
catalysts.description: Sulfur dioxide oxidation catalysts manufactured by JSC "SZK". Catalyst screening, loading, and unloading services.

list.item1: Vanadium HT catalysts — optimized for low-temperature operating conditions.
list.item2: Vanadium VT catalysts — ensure stable performance under standard operating conditions.
list.item3: Cesium catalysts — provide maximum activity and productivity.

catalysts.note: We provide technical selection, supply, logistics, and implementation support for catalysts produced by the Samara Catalyst Plant (SZK).

technologies.title: TECHNOLOGIES AND EQUIPMENT
technologies.description: Sulfuric acid production technologies DCDA and Wet Catalysis (WSA). Gas cleaning technologies (washing towers, Dyna-Wave counter-current scrubbers, electrostatic precipitators). Phosphogypsum utilization technologies and phosphoric acid production processes. Ammonia production technologies (Casale supply scope). Sulfuric acid alkylation technologies and spent acid regeneration.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Contact us for technical consultation, catalyst selection, or a commercial proposal. We are always open to cooperation and ready to answer any questions.
